_doc: Stage 1 of the Florida-to-Bahamas map (docs/world-bimini): North and South Bimini, Gun Cay and Cat Cay on the edge of the Great Bahama Bank. 10 m cells from the NOAA ENC cells that reach Bimini (chart 11469, 'Fowey Rocks, Hillsboro Inlet to Bimini Islands'), flat low land (no free lidar; islands are a few metres high), Virginia Key's datums for MLLW until a Bimini tide model is baked (FES2022, AVISO: commercial use allowed). The Bahamas side is coarse: reefs, the harbour and the cays need hand work (docs/world-bimini/README.md). Positions are approximate (gazetteers and the US chart), checked by the bake's checkpoints.
name: Bimini
display: Bimini and the Great Bahama Bank edge

datum.name: MLLW (chart datum); heights in meters above it

tides.note: no CO-OPS harmonic station in the Bahamas: Virginia Key stands in (Bimini's range is similar, about 0.8 m springs) until FES2022 constituents are baked for Bimini
